reason: The original card compares IID, Sobol, randomized Sobol and soft topographical ordering but omits the current product H0 coordinator, which interleaves counter-based IID with deterministic Halton proposals and fair pending/refinement service. The current solver must be measured as a control before any replacement is promoted.

diagnostic_exclusion.scope: Six frozen MULTIROOT-WARPED development instances, 32 all-launch Halton starts, and the existing LXR-LMQR local control.
diagnostic_exclusion.observation: The diagnostic recovered every target in one of six instances, versus two of six in the already-recorded IID-start local experiment, and did not recover any target in the four 1e-3 or 1e-6 close-root instances that failed locally.
diagnostic_exclusion.restriction: This was not the product coordinator, did not use the EXP-DISC seed design, and was inspected before formal input freezing. It may motivate inclusion of controls only; it cannot set thresholds, tune a mix, select a candidate, count toward a gate, or enter development/locked artifacts.

literature.claim: Halton constructs a multidimensional low-discrepancy sequence from radical-inverse sequences in relatively prime bases for numerical integration.
literature.assumptions: The formal result concerns distribution and quadrature in a bounded cube.
literature.break_conditions: Low discrepancy does not imply favorable hitting probabilities for nonlinear root basins, and a deterministic prefix supplies no seed-wise uncertainty.

mandatory_controls.description: Replay the complete current bounded-problem coordinator with SolvePolicy version 1.0.0: lane weights IID=4, heuristic=3, shell=2, pending=12, refinement=2; IID cadence 4; counter-IID and task-indexed Halton proposal sources; unchanged pending/refinement behavior, local solver, validator, budgets and checkpoint semantics.
mandatory_controls.accounting: Charge proposal generation, every pending and refinement action, local work, target-image diagnostics, canonical validation, compile/JIT, and result construction. Report proposal and completed-local prefixes separately so scheduling overhead cannot be hidden.
mandatory_controls.immutability: The control is reconstructed from the committed production policy and its policy/proposal-engine hashes; no experimental knob may alter it.

mandatory_controls.description: Launch every deterministic task-indexed Halton point in order with the same local policy and no IID mixing, ranking, suppression or deferred queue.
mandatory_controls.accounting: Charge the same point generation, local, validation, compile and result costs as D0-IID-ALL.
mandatory_controls.immutability: Uses the production Halton implementation and its documented dimension fallback without scrambling or post-hoc skipping.

pairing_addendum: D-H0-CURRENT, D-HALTON-ALL and every original variant use the same frozen problem instances, local champion, truth, wall/oracle budgets and target matching. Where proposal streams differ, persist the complete generated prefixes and checksums. Compile/JIT is reported cold and warm rather than amortized away.

decision_addendum.candidate_comparison: Apply the original promotion and kill gates against D0-IID-ALL and also report paired deltas against D-H0-CURRENT. A new policy may replace the current product only after it passes development and untouched family-disjoint locked gates with zero safety violations.
decision_addendum.current_control_outcome: D-H0-CURRENT is a regression control, not a protected champion. If it loses, it remains in production until a locked candidate passes; if every candidate fails, retain the simplest passing control under the original rule.
decision_addendum.halton_outcome: D-HALTON-ALL cannot be promoted on this amendment. If it is within five percent of IID/Sobol controls on recall and cost, remove the separate all-Halton mechanism from further candidate code; retain the historical result.
decision_addendum.close_root_routing: A start-source comparison cannot claim to repair a stratum in which every paired local attempt fails after entering the same neighborhood. Such cases are classified for local/refinement research and remain in discovery safety reporting.

freeze_rule: Freeze this amendment together with the original card before generating formal EXP-DISC development inputs. No result from the excluded diagnostic may appear in a formal manifest.
